Bihar Vidhan Parishad Security Guard Interview Admit Card 2026

Post Date: June 9, 2026

11:36 am

Bihar Vidhan Parishad, has release the Interview Admit Card on its official website for the Reporter, Assistant, Assistant Caretaker, Data Entry Operator (DEO), Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Security Guard, Driver and Office Attendant Examination 2024. The Interview will be conducted on June 2026, The Bihar Vidhan Parishad application process started on 16 October 2024, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 25 October 2024. Candidates can check their Interview Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (Advt. No: 01/2023, 02/2023, 03/2023 & 04/2023)

Post Name Eligibility Criteria
Reporter
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree from a university recognized by the State or Central Government. They should have Hindi stenography speed of 150 words per minute and typing speed of 35 words per minute in both Hindi and English. Additionally, candidates must possess a computer certificate recognized by AICTE or DOEACC/NIELIT (equivalent to ‘O’ Level), or must have passed a Computer Proficiency Test.
Assistant
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree from a State or Central Government recognized university. They should have a typing speed of 30 words per minute in both Hindi and English and must also possess a computer course certificate from AICTE, DOEACC, or NIELIT.
Assistant Caretaker
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree from a university recognized by the State or Central Government.
Data Entry Operator (DEO)
  • Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) from a recognized board or council of the State or Central Government. They should also have a typing speed of 8000 key depressions per hour (KDPH) on computer.
Lower Division Clerk (LDC)
  • Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) from a recognized board or council of the State or Central Government. They should also have a typing speed of 30 words per minute in both Hindi and English.
Security Guard
  • Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) in any subject from a recognized board or council of the State or Central Government. For physical standards, male candidates should have a height of 167.5 cm (relaxation of 2.4 cm for Terai region), chest 76.5–81 cm, and vision 6/12 without glasses. Female candidates should have a height of 154.6 cm (with similar relaxation for Terai region) and vision 6/12 without glasses. Candidates must be physically fit and free from diseases. Additionally, male candidates must complete a 1.6 km run in 6 minutes, and female candidates must complete a 1 km run in 6 minutes. Preference will be given to candidates with an NCC ‘C’ certificate or those who have represented the state, country, or university in sports at a recognized level.
Driver
  • Candidates must have passed 10th (Matriculation) from a recognized board in India and must possess a valid driving license (LMV/HMV).
Office Attendant
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) or equivalent from a recognized board. They should have a working knowledge of both Hindi and English languages and must also know how to ride a bicycle.
Office Attendant (Watchman)
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) or equivalent from a recognized board. They should have a working knowledge of both Hindi and English languages and must also have the ability to ride a bicycle.
Office Attendant (Faras)
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) or equivalent from a recognized board. They should have a working knowledge of both Hindi and English languages and must also have the ability to ride a bicycle.
Office Attendant (Sweeper)
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) or equivalent from a recognized board. They should have a working knowledge of both Hindi and English languages and must also have the ability to ride a bicycle.
Office Attendant (Mali)
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) or equivalent from a recognized board. They should have a working knowledge of both Hindi and English languages and must also have the ability to ride a bicycle.

 How To Check & Download Bihar Vidhan Parishad Security Guard Interview Admit Card 2026 
  • Go to the official website of the
    Bihar Vidhan Parishad
  • On the homepage, click on:
    “Recruitment” / “Latest Announcements”
  • Find and click on:
    “Security Guard Interview Letter 2026”
  • Open the login page
  • Enter your details:
  • Registration Number / Roll Number
  • Date of Birth / Password
  • Click on Login / Submit
  • Your Admit Card will appear on the screen
  • Download the PDF and take a printout
